column1: # The MMC plant from build_mmc_grid() is behind an SCR-8 grid with X/R = 10.
# This package exports the circuit to PSCAD 5.1.0 with a 1e-6 s step and 10 s duration.
# Measurement windows are [8, 9) and [9, 10) s; current tone peak amplitude is 8.553820834429869e-4 pu per tone.
# AC terminal admittance is in S at the 400 kV transformer side; a stiff source holds DC voltage at 640 kV.
# The fixed nominal 50 Hz dq frame uses positive-sine q and current into the MMC.
